record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_timing: Formal policy: dated evidence; numeric duration withheld; see qualification
record.current_corrections: The Friday announcement date derives to 15 January 2021, not an observed land-gate denial. August reporting concerns a continuing Gambian chick restriction; hearsay about Senegal’s own rule is not a Gambian lifting. Affected origins and poultry products remain scoped. No continuous physical-closure interval or endpoint is established. The August source directly confirms the chick subgroup; it does not establish a same-date restatement for the full live-bird, meat, egg and affected-origin set. The combined phase’s Last confirmed field is therefore left empty.
